finalText:
All 12 non-vendored call sites are migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`; the `@deprecated` tag on `db.query` in `lib/db.js:12` can now be actioned (or the method removed) once you're ready.

One file left on `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It's explicitly marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it as-is. If that adapter needs to move too, it'll require either patching upstream `legacy-orm` or keeping `db.query` around as a shim for it.
